message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: selling adult health products containing toxic/harmful ingredients, specifically containing prescription drug sildenafil (西地那非). Illegal sale of drugs without license. Likely crime: illegal manufacturing/ selling of counterfeit or unapproved drugs, or illegal sale of harmful food/medicine. In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "非法生产、销售假药罪" (illegal production and sale of counterfeit drugs) or "非法生产、销售药品罪". Also "非法经营罪" maybe. The examples: earlier similar case: "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药". For drug case: "容留他人吸毒". For counterfeit goods: "假冒注册商标". For illegal sale of harmful products: maybe "非法生产、销售有毒有害食品罪". But these are health products with drug ingredient, likely "非法生产、销售假药罪". The fact says "含有有毒、有害成分的性保健品". So crime: "非法生产、销售假药罪". Also maybe "非法经营罪" (illegal business). But typical classification: "非法生产、销售假药罪" (Article 141 of Criminal Law). So answer: [罪名]非法生产、销售假药<eoa>
